question: Which of the following was the capital of Vajji gana during Mahajanapadas period?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vaishali.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The capital of Vajji Gana during the Mahajanapadas period was **Vaishali.**
 
• Vaishali is the **Bihar** state in present India.
 
• Vaishali, the **world's first republic** was founded by **Licchavi.**
 
• Vaishali is also the** birthplace of Mahavira Swami.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vajji was under a different form of government, known as Gana or Sangha. 

 
 
• In a Gana or a sangha there were not one, but many rulers.
 
• Sometimes, there were multiple men ruled together, each one was known as a Raja.
 
• These Rajas performed rituals together. They also met in assemblies, and decided what had to be done and how, through discussion and debate.
 
 
 
• Mahajanapadas were in existence from **600 B.C to 345 B.C.**
 
• Most of the Mahajanapadas had a capital city and were covered by huge walls.
 
• There were a total of 16 Mahajanapadas-
